title: Judge
subtitle: 「判斷／評價」，究竟是哪一種判斷？
description: 「判斷／評價」，究竟是哪一種判斷？

words.note: 最直接、常見的近義詞之一，表示根據資料、表現或情況作出較有系統的判斷。
words.example: The panel will assess each proposal against the published criteria.
words.exampleZh: 評審小組會按照公布的準則評估每項建議。

exercises.original: The panel will judge each proposal against the published criteria.
exercises.zh: 評審小組會按照公布的準則評估每項建議。

options.explanation: guess = 有 published criteria，因此不是猜測。
criticize = 不一定只找缺點。
assess = against the published criteria 表示有系統地按標準判斷，因此 assess 最精確。
observe = 只是觀察，不包含整體判斷。
decide = 本句是在評估 proposals，未必立即作最終選擇。
measure = criteria 不一定全部可量化。

exercises.original: Doctors must judge the severity of the injury before deciding on treatment.
exercises.zh: 醫生必須先判斷傷勢嚴重程度，再決定治療方法。

options.explanation: guess = 醫療判斷不能只是猜。
criticize = 不合。
observe = 醫生會觀察，但句子要求判斷 severity。
assess = 判斷 injury 的 severity 是典型專業 assessment。
rate = 可用某些量表，但本句未提供分級尺度。
assume = 不是預設。

exercises.original: The company is judging the risks associated with entering the new market.
exercises.zh: 公司正在評估進入新市場的相關風險。

options.explanation: guessing = 風險評估需要資料和分析。
criticizing = 不是批評市場。
measuring = 部分風險可量化，但整體評估更廣。
observing = 不只觀察。
assess = risks associated with... 是正式商業評估語境，assessing 最自然。
deciding = 尚在風險判斷階段。

words.note: 較正式，強調衡量某事物的質素、成效、價值或表現，常見於教育、研究和工作語境。
words.example: The committee will evaluate the programme after its first year.
words.exampleZh: 委員會會在計劃第一年結束後評估其成效。

exercises.original: The researchers will judge whether the new teaching method is effective.
exercises.zh: 研究人員會評估新的教學方法是否有效。

options.explanation: guess = 研究不應靠猜。
criticize = 不是只指出缺點。
observe = 僅觀察不足以判斷 effectiveness。
evaluate = 研究語境中判斷 method 的 effectiveness，evaluate 最自然。
assume = 不是預設結論。
size up = 過於口語。

exercises.original: The committee judged the programme after reviewing its first-year results.
exercises.zh: 委員會在檢視首年結果後評估了這項計劃。

options.explanation: measured = 可以量度某些數據，但不是整體 programme quality。
criticized = 未必是負面結果。
guessed = 不合。
observed = 不等於評估。
evaluate = 先 review results 再判斷 programme 成效，evaluated 很精確。
decided = 沒有說選擇哪一方案。

exercises.original: Students were asked to judge the reliability of each source.
exercises.zh: 學生被要求評估每個資料來源的可靠性。

options.explanation: assume = 不應預設可靠。
guess = 不合學術任務。
criticize = 不一定每個 source 都有問題。
measure = reliability 未必能直接用數值量度。
observe = 只閱讀觀察不足。
evaluate = 判斷 source reliability 是典型 evaluate 任務。

words.note: 描述性說法，強調根據所見所聞對某人或某事逐步形成看法，而不一定有正式評分。
words.example: It is difficult to form an opinion of someone after a single meeting.
words.exampleZh: 只見過一次面很難對一個人形成看法。

exercises.original: Try not to judge a new colleague after only one conversation.
exercises.zh: 不要只談過一次話便對新同事形成看法。
exercises.upgrade: form an opinion of · 對……形成看法；評斷

options.explanation: measure = 人不是以數值直接量度。
rate = 除非有正式評分，否則太機械化。
adjudicate = 只用於正式裁決。
review = 通常需要較有系統的資料或表現。
form an opinion of = 句子說的是根據短暫接觸對一個人形成印象，form an opinion of 最貼切。
observe = 只是觀看，不包含形成看法。

exercises.original: It is difficult to judge someone fairly when you have heard only one side of the story.
exercises.zh: 只聽過一方說法時，很難公平地對一個人形成看法。
exercises.upgrade: form an opinion of · 對……形成看法；評斷

options.explanation: rate = 沒有評分尺度。
measure = 不合。
adjudicate = 不是正式裁決案件。
size up = 太口語，而且容易有快速打量意味。
review = 不自然形容對某人的一般看法。
form an opinion of = one side of the story 強調資訊不足下形成個人看法，因此這個改寫最自然。

exercises.original: People often judge public figures from short clips online.
exercises.zh: 人們常根據網上短片對公眾人物形成看法。
exercises.upgrade: form an opinion of · 對……形成看法；評斷

options.explanation: form an opinion of = 從短片形成印象或觀點，而非正式評分，因此 form an opinion of 最自然。
measure = 不合。
rate = 可在線評分，但本句是一般看法。
adjudicate = 不合。
review = 較像正式評論。
appraise = 通常用於價值或正式表現評估。

words.note: 較正式，表示有系統地判斷價值、質素或表現；常見於房產、藝術品、工作表現等語境。
words.example: A specialist was asked to appraise the painting before the sale.
words.exampleZh: 拍賣前，一名專家受邀為這幅畫作估值。

exercises.original: A specialist was asked to judge the value of the painting before the auction.
exercises.zh: 拍賣前，一名專家受邀評估這幅畫的價值。

options.explanation: guess = 專家估值不能只是猜。
criticize = 不是找畫作缺點。
observe = 只是看，不包含估值。
rate = 可能給分，但 auction 前重點是價值鑑定。
decide = 太泛。
appraise = value + before the auction 是典型 appraise 語境。

exercises.original: The bank hired an expert to judge the property before approving the loan.
exercises.zh: 銀行聘請專家在批出貸款前評估物業價值。

options.explanation: appraise = 貸款前由專家判斷 property value，標準動詞是 appraise。
rate = 可以評級，但 property valuation 更標準是 appraise。
observe = 不夠。
guess = 不合專業估值。
criticize = 不合。
review = 較廣，未必包括正式估價。

exercises.original: Managers judge employee performance during the annual review process.
exercises.zh: 經理會在年度評核程序中評估員工表現。

options.explanation: guess = 不合。
appraise = annual review process 中正式評估 employee performance，可用 appraise。
observe = 只觀察不足以完成 annual review。
criticize = 績效評估不一定是負面批評。
measure = 部分可量化，但整體 performance appraisal 更廣。
decide = 太泛。

words.note: 表示按照某個尺度、等級或標準給予分數或等級，常見於問卷、產品、服務和表現評價。
words.example: Customers were asked to rate the service from one to five.
words.exampleZh: 顧客被要求以一至五分評價服務。

exercises.original: Customers were asked to judge the service from one to five.
exercises.zh: 顧客被要求以一至五分評價服務。

options.explanation: rate = from one to five 明確要求評分，因此 rate 最自然。
assess = 也可，但有明確 1–5 scale 時 rate 更精確。
review = 可以寫評論，但不一定給數值。
guess = 不合。
observe = 不合。
adjudicate = 不合。

exercises.original: Participants judged each statement on a seven-point scale.
exercises.zh: 參加者以七點量表評價每項陳述。

options.explanation: appraised = 通常不對 statements 用價值鑑定。
rate = seven-point scale 是 rate 的直接線索。
reviewed = 可能閱讀，但不表示給分。
guessed = 不合。
observed = 不合。
weighed up = 是權衡利弊，不是量表評分。

exercises.original: The website lets users judge restaurants by giving them up to five stars.
exercises.zh: 網站讓用戶以最多五星評價餐廳。

options.explanation: review = review 可寫文字評論，但 five stars 指 rating。
assess = 較正式，而且不突出星級。
rate = up to five stars 明確是評級，因此 rate 最精確。
appraise = 不合餐廳體驗。
guess = 不合。
adjudicate = 不合。

words.note: 表示重新查看資料、表現或情況，再作出判斷；常見於工作、文件、申請和政策語境。
words.example: The manager will review your performance at the end of the month.
words.exampleZh: 經理會在月底評核你的工作表現。

exercises.original: The manager will judge your performance at the end of the month.
exercises.zh: 經理會在月底評核你的工作表現。

options.explanation: guess = 不合正式工作評核。
review = 工作表現定期評核常用 review performance。
criticize = review 不一定負面。
observe = 只是看，不等於評核。
adjudicate = 不合。
size up = 太口語。

exercises.original: The admissions team will judge each application before making a decision.
exercises.zh: 招生團隊會在作決定前審視每份申請。

options.explanation: rate = 未說以分數評級。
guess = 不合。
review = 逐份查看 application 再作決定，review 最自然。
criticize = 不合。
measure = application 不是單純量化。
adjudicate = 除非是正式爭議，不合。

exercises.original: The board will judge the policy again after six months.
exercises.zh: 董事會會在六個月後再次審視這項政策。

options.explanation: guess = 不合。
size up = 太口語。
rate = 未提供評分尺度。
review = again after six months 表示重新審視，因此 review 最精確。
observe = 不完整。
pass judgment on = 語氣更強，像作最終價值裁斷。

words.note: 強調從跡象、反應或有限資訊估計程度、情緒、需求或情況。
words.example: The speaker paused to gauge the audience's reaction.
words.exampleZh: 講者停了一下，以判斷觀眾的反應。

exercises.original: The speaker paused to judge the audience's reaction.
exercises.zh: 講者停了一下，以判斷觀眾的反應。

options.explanation: rate = 沒有數值尺度。
appraise = 不合 reaction。
gauge = 講者從現場反應快速估量 audience response，gauge 最自然。
adjudicate = 不合。
review = 通常需要較完整資料。
measure = 可量度某些反應，但本句是從現場線索估量。

exercises.original: We need to judge how much support the proposal has before the vote.
exercises.zh: 投票前，我們需要判斷這項建議有多少支持。

options.explanation: rate = 沒有要求打分。
review = 不如 gauge 表達估計程度。
adjudicate = 不合。
gauge = how much support 要估計程度，gauge 最貼切。
criticize = 不合。
observe = 只觀察不足以估計 support level。

exercises.original: The company surveyed customers to judge demand for the new service.
exercises.zh: 公司調查顧客，以判斷新服務的需求程度。

options.explanation: rate = customers 可以 rate service，但這裡公司要估 demand。
appraise = 不合 demand。
review = 太泛。
decide = 不是直接作選擇。
gauge = survey 用來估計 demand level，典型搭配是 gauge demand。
guess = 有 survey evidence，因此不是猜。

words.note: 較常見於英式英語，表示把多個因素、利弊或選項放在一起考慮後再作判斷。
words.example: We need to weigh up the risks before making a final decision.
words.exampleZh: 我們需要在作出最終決定前仔細權衡風險。

exercises.original: We need to judge the advantages and disadvantages before making a decision.
exercises.zh: 我們需要在作決定前權衡利弊。
exercises.upgrade: weigh up · 權衡；仔細評估

options.explanation: rate = 不是給每項打分。
observe = 不夠。
guess = 不合。
weigh up = advantages and disadvantages 是典型需要權衡的兩面，因此 weigh up 最自然。
appraise = 較正式且不如 weigh up 突出利弊比較。
adjudicate = 不合。

exercises.original: She judged the risks carefully before accepting the offer.
exercises.zh: 她在接受這項提議前仔細權衡了風險。
exercises.upgrade: weigh up · 權衡；仔細評估

options.explanation: rated = 沒有評分尺度。
observed = 不代表考慮取捨。
guessed = 不合 carefully。
reviewed = 可審視，但不如 weigh up 表達決策前權衡。
weigh up = 決策前仔細考慮 risks，weighed up 很貼切。
size up = 較快速、口語，和 carefully 不完全相同。

exercises.original: The committee judged several competing priorities before allocating the budget.
exercises.zh: 委員會在分配預算前權衡了數個互相競爭的優先事項。
exercises.upgrade: weigh up · 權衡；仔細評估

options.explanation: rated = 可能評級，但本句是取捨。
observed = 不夠。
guessed = 不合。
adjudicated = 不是法律裁決。
measured = priorities 不能單純量度。
weigh up = competing priorities + budget allocation 是典型權衡語境。

words.note: 較口語，表示快速觀察某人、情況或對手，以判斷其性格、能力或可能性。
words.example: The coach quickly sized up the opposing team before the match.
words.exampleZh: 教練在比賽前迅速判斷對手的實力。

exercises.original: The coach quickly judged the opposing team before the match began.
exercises.zh: 教練在比賽開始前迅速判斷對手實力。
exercises.upgrade: size up · 打量；迅速判斷

options.explanation: appraised = 太正式。
adjudicated = 完全不合。
rated = 沒有評分尺度。
reviewed = 可用但沒有快速直覺判斷感。
size up = quickly + opponent observation 是 size up 的典型語境。
measured = 不合整支隊伍的整體印象。

exercises.original: She judged the situation in a few seconds and decided to leave.
exercises.zh: 她在數秒內判斷形勢，然後決定離開。
exercises.upgrade: size up · 打量；迅速判斷

options.explanation: reviewed = 通常需要較長時間或更多資料。
appraised = 過於正式。
rated = 沒有量表。
adjudicated = 不合。
measured = 不合整體 situation。
size up = in a few seconds 強調快速打量和判斷，因此 sized up 最自然。

exercises.original: The interviewer judged each candidate's confidence as they entered the room.
exercises.zh: 面試官在候選人進房時便迅速判斷其自信程度。
exercises.upgrade: size up · 打量；迅速判斷

options.explanation: size up = 剛進房便快速形成判斷，size up 很貼切。
reviewed = 尚未有完整 interview 資料。
rated = 未說有評分表。
appraised = 過於正式且像完整評核。
adjudicated = 不合。
measured = confidence 未必可直接量度。

words.note: 較正式或帶批判意味，表示對某人、行為或情況作出明確判斷；常帶有道德或價值評價色彩。
words.example: It is unfair to pass judgment on someone without knowing the full story.
words.exampleZh: 在不了解完整情況前就對一個人下判斷並不公平。

exercises.original: It is unfair to judge someone without knowing the full story.
exercises.zh: 在不了解完整情況前就對一個人下判斷並不公平。
exercises.upgrade: pass judgment on · 對……下判斷；評斷

options.explanation: rate = 不是評分。
review = 不是正式檢視資料。
gauge = 較像估量程度，不是價值判斷。
appraise = 不合一般人物道德評價。
measure = 不合。
pass judgment on = without knowing the full story 表示不應過早作價值判斷，因此 pass judgment on 最自然。

exercises.original: People should not judge others simply because of their appearance.
exercises.zh: 人們不應只因外表便對別人下判斷。
exercises.upgrade: pass judgment on · 對……下判斷；評斷

options.explanation: pass judgment on = 對人的 appearance 作價值性評斷，pass judgment on 很貼切。
assess = 較中性，不足以表達批判性 judgment。
rate = 會像打分。
review = 不合。
gauge = 不合。
appraise = 不自然。

exercises.original: The article avoids judging whether the lifestyle is morally right or wrong.
exercises.zh: 文章避免判斷這種生活方式在道德上是對還是錯。
exercises.upgrade: pass judgment on · 對……下判斷；評斷

options.explanation: evaluating = 可用，但 moral right or wrong 更強調價值裁斷。
pass judgment on = morally right or wrong 明確是價值判斷，因此 passing judgment on 最精確。
rating = 不合。
reviewing = 不合。
gauging = 不合。
measuring = 不合。

words.note: 法律、比賽或正式爭議語境中的專門用語，表示由有權限的人或機構作出正式裁決。
words.example: An independent panel will adjudicate the dispute.
words.exampleZh: 一個獨立小組將就這宗爭議作出裁決。

exercises.original: An independent panel will judge the dispute between the two organizations.
exercises.zh: 一個獨立小組將就兩個機構之間的爭議作出裁決。

options.explanation: adjudicate = independent panel + dispute 表示正式裁決，因此 adjudicate 最精確。
review = 可以審查資料，但不一定有權作正式裁決。
rate = 不合爭議。
gauge = 不合。
size up = 過於口語。
guess = 完全不合。

exercises.original: The tribunal was established to judge claims arising from the contract.
exercises.zh: 仲裁庭成立的目的是裁決由合約引起的申索。

options.explanation: assess = 可以評估 claims，但 tribunal 的角色是作正式決定。
adjudicate = tribunal + claims 是典型 adjudicate 法律語境。
review = 不足以表達裁決權。
rate = 不合。
size up = 不合正式法律語境。
observe = 不合。

exercises.original: A panel of judges will judge the final round of the competition.
exercises.zh: 一個評判小組將裁決比賽最後一輪。

options.explanation: guess = 不合。
observe = 不夠。
adjudicate = 由正式 panel 對 competition 結果作裁定時，adjudicate 可精確使用。
review = 可能會 review entries，但 final outcome 需要正式裁定。
measure = 不完整。
criticize = 不合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 猜測不等於判斷 guess 通常是在資訊不足下猜答案；judge 可以是基於證據、觀察或標準作出判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A guess may be unsupported; a judgment is usually based on some evidence or criteria.

falseSynonyms.zh: 批評不等於判斷 criticize 強調指出缺點或表達不滿；judge 可以作正面、中性或負面的評估。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can judge a performance positively without criticizing it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 決定不完全等於評估 decide 是作出選擇或結論；judge 更強調形成評價或衡量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You may judge the options first and then decide which one to choose.

falseSynonyms.zh: 測量不等於判斷 measure 通常取得數值或尺寸；judge 可以根據量度結果再作整體評估。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can measure a result and then judge whether it is acceptable.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觀察不等於判斷 observe 是注意或記錄所見；judge 是在觀察後形成評價。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Observation provides information; judgment interprets it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞與名詞不同 judge 是動詞；judgment（英式也寫 judgement）是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We judge the evidence. We then make a judgment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 評估與假設不同 assess 是根據資訊作評估；assume 是在未充分證明前把某事當作真的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Assess the evidence carefully rather than assuming the answer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 評估與重視不同 evaluate 是判斷質素或價值；value 可表示重視，也可表示估價，兩者不能一般互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We evaluate the programme's effectiveness, but we value the staff's contribution.
